CONNECT YOUR SOUND

Patch bay

Plug sources into effects, then cable them to your headphones, speakers or virtual cable.

QUICK START

Make a connection: drag from a right-hand socket to a left-hand socket, or click the two sockets. Click a cable to unplug it. Right-click to cancel a connection or node move. Drag node headers to arrange your rack. Multiple cables into an effect mix those sources; its output can feed multiple destinations. The microphone switch and output volume above still apply.

Settings

Changes apply automatically and are remembered on this computer.

Keyboard & MIDI

Assigned shortcuts work while Quiet Lab remains open. Reserved shortcuts are reported rather than overridden.

VST3 plugin folders

Standard Windows VST3 folders are scanned automatically. Add any extra folders below, one per line, then use Scan plugins in Effects.

VST3 audio effects only. VST2, instruments and MIDI routing into plugins are not supported.

Microphones
